exposed_pad.note: TPS54331DR uses standard non-thermal-pad SOIC-8 (D) package (PowerPAD exists ONLY on DDA suffix TPS54331DDAR, p.3).

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: JEDEC high-K board, D 8-pin SOIC without PowerPAD (do NOT confuse with DDA PowerPAD 48.7°C/W!)

tj_max_c.condition: Recommended operating junction temperature max 150°C (-40°C to 150°C; TSD typ 165°C p.5)

pinout.name: BOOT
pinout.description: High-side MOSFET gate-drive bootstrap capacitor pin (connect 0.1 uF ceramic cap to PH).

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.description: Wide input supply voltage pin (3.5 V to 28.0 V; 30 V abs max).

pinout.name: EN
pinout.description: Active-high enable with internal pull-up; float to enable (STRICTLY <= 6.0 V abs max!).

pinout.name: SS
pinout.description: External slow-start capacitor pin (sets soft-start ramp time; leave open for ~1 ms internal ramp).

pinout.name: VSENSE
pinout.description: Inverting error-amplifier feedback input (VREF = 0.800 V typ).

pinout.name: COMP
pinout.description: Error-amplifier output for mandatory external Type-II RC loop compensation network.

pinout.name: PH
pinout.description: Switch node source of integrated 80 mOhm high-side N-FET; requires external Schottky catch diode to GND.

vin_abs_max_v.condition: VIN abs max -0.3 V to 30 V (EN abs max ONLY 6.0 V; PH transient 32 V < 10 ns)

vout_min_v.condition: Minimum adjustable output voltage down to 0.800 V internal reference

vout_max_v.condition: Constrained by 91% typical max duty cycle at 28 V input (Eq. 32 p.21)

vref_v.condition: VSENSE reference typ 0.800 V (0.772 V to 0.828 V over -40°C to 150°C TJ)

iout_or_isw_max_ma.condition: 3 A continuous output current (HS current limit min 3.5 A, typ 5.8 A per p.5)

iq_typ_ua.condition: Operating non-switching quiescent current 110 uA typ (max 190 uA; shutdown 1 uA typ)

fsw_typ_khz.condition: Fixed 570 kHz typ oscillator (456 kHz to 684 kHz over -40°C to 150°C TJ)

efficiency_peak_pct.condition: Peak ~94% at VIN = 5 V, VOUT = 3.3 V, IOUT ~ 0.5 A (~88% peak at VIN = 12 V, VOUT = 3.3 V)
efficiency_peak_pct.table_ref: Page 1 Efficiency vs Output Current (300 DPI Vision verified)

inductor_typ_uh.condition: 6.8 uH in 3.3 V / 3 A reference design (typical application range 6.8 uH to 47 uH)

min_cout_uf.condition: Reference design uses 2 x 47 uF ceramic (minimum crossover stability calculation 5.8 uF per Eq. 12 p.17)

design_gotchas.title: Non-Synchronous Architecture Requires External Schottky Catch Diode & External COMP Network
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike synchronous SOT-23-6 peers (TPS54302DDCR, AP63203WU-7, AP62200WU-7), TPS54331DR integrates only the high-side 80 mOhm MOSFET and requires an external 40 V / 3 A+ Schottky freewheeling diode (e.g., B340A) plus external Type-II RC compensation on COMP (Pin 6).

design_gotchas.title: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 6.0 V — NEVER Connect Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN
design_gotchas.detail: Pin 3 (EN) has a 6.0 V absolute maximum rating despite 28 V VIN capability. Float EN to auto-enable (internal pull-up) or use a resistive UVLO divider from VIN that keeps VEN safely below 5 V at maximum line surge.

design_gotchas.title: Standard SOIC-8 (D) RthetaJA = 116.3°C/W Has NO Exposed Pad (vs 48.7°C/W on DDA Suffix)
design_gotchas.detail: TPS54331DR is the standard non-PowerPAD SOIC-8 ('D') package with 2.4x higher thermal resistance (116.3°C/W) than the exposed-pad SOIC-8E 'DDA' package (48.7°C/W). Verify package dissipation at 3 A load and high ambient temperature or select TPS54331DDAR.

design_gotchas.title: Lower Efficiency (~86-88% at 12 V/24 V) and Higher BOM Count vs Modern Synchronous Bucks
design_gotchas.detail: At 12 V or 24 V input into 3.3 V/5 V at 3 A, external Schottky diode forward drop dissipates > 1 W outside the IC, reducing efficiency compared to synchronous TPS54302DDCR (~95% peak) and increasing PCB footprint.

typical_use_cases: Legacy 12 V and 24 V industrial/consumer power rails requiring programmable UVLO, external soft-start, and custom loop compensation
Wide 3.5 V to 28 V step-down up to 3 A where -40°C to 150°C TJ rating and SOIC-8 inspectable leads are preferred
High-volume distributed power buses, printers, and set-top boxes with external Schottky diode dissipation sharing
engineering_summary: The TPS54331DR is a 3.5 V to 28 V input, 3 A non-synchronous current-mode buck converter in standard SOIC-8 (D, no exposed pad) integrating an 80 mOhm high-side MOSFET, 570 kHz oscillator, Eco-mode light-load pulse skipping (110 uA Iq), adjustable UVLO/soft-start, and a wide -40°C to 150°C recommended TJ range. Compared to modern synchronous SOT-23-6 bucks, it requires an external Schottky catch diode and COMP RC network, suffers 116.3°C/W RthetaJA (vs 48.7°C/W on DDA PowerPAD), and caps EN at 6.0 V abs max. Verify thermal derating and compensation design in the TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 confirmed D 8-pin SOIC Top View pinout (1=BOOT, 2=VIN, 3=EN, 4=SS, 5=VSENSE, 6=COMP, 7=GND, 8=PH) with NO exposed pad (explicitly differentiated from DDA PowerPAD package).
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max VIN 30 V, EN 6.0 V, Rec Op VIN 3.5-28 V, and Rec Op TJ -40 to 150 C.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 confirmed non-synchronous schematic with external Schottky catch diode and ~94% peak efficiency at VIN = 5 V, VOUT = 3.3 V (~88% at VIN = 12 V).
